trigger: Official process or deadline remains unknown
mitigation: Confirm route and exact deadline with supervisor; retain actual decision
next_review: Before data acquisition and at next supervisor meeting

trigger: Several parameter/action combinations fit the same speed trace
impact: Unsupported claims about real ERS behaviour
mitigation: Bound parameters; synthetic recovery; multiple starts; report families of plausible maps

trigger: Test trace contributes to preprocessing geometry envelopes profiles or tuning
mitigation: Freeze grouped manifests and permitted inputs; separate inverse diagnostics from forward tests

trigger: Missing sessions or unsuitable qualifying laps
impact: Reporting circuit or broad-data objective becomes infeasible
mitigation: Pilot one event; catalogue failures and retention; select circuit from evidence
next_review: At pilot and each season inclusion audit

trigger: Controller difference is below integration or DP grid error
mitigation: Independent physics check; energy/braking checks; grid refinement; report uncertainty

trigger: Pilot runtime or DP memory exceeds available resources
mitigation: Measure small pilot; student sets ceiling; prioritise core and record reduced scope
next_review: After hardware inventory and before heavy runs

trigger: Terms do not establish intended access or redistribution
mitigation: Review source-specific terms; retain provenance; distribute acquisition instructions where needed

trigger: Optional methods begin before core gates pass
mitigation: Defer SAC regeneration and unseen-track transfer; condition profile study on resources

trigger: Car tyres fuel or traffic differ between compared drivers
mitigation: Use observable profile language; match context where feasible; sensitivity analysis
next_review: At profile design and discussion draft

trigger: Claim lacks a source locator or actual run artifact
mitigation: Maintain assistance log; verify references and commands; student writes personal reflection
Populate deadline register from SurreyLearn and supervisor evidence

trigger: Historical telemetry spans vehicle regulatory or layout changes
mitigation: Record season regime and layout; assign justified uses; separate 2026 model; exclude with reasons
